{{Top|leg}}
A '''genetic sampler''', also known as a '''Genetic Scanner''', was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] utilized by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries']] [[Mark VII "Inquisitor" Series Seeker Droid]]. The sampler could analyze organic material, such as [[Hair/Legends|hair]], skin, and [[Blood/Legends|blood]], and compare them with the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] internal records to identity their source.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
